observations.note: All reported jobs passed including five Worker Wrangler dry-runs, contracts, runtime-memory schema and CHAIN gauntlet.

conclusions: Immediate absence of a workflow run was a timing false negative.
Cloudflare targets progress asynchronously and must be tracked independently.
Explicit Cloudflare build failures are real failures, but their exact causes remain unresolved without build logs.
GitHub Wrangler dry-run success plus Cloudflare build failure localizes investigation toward the Cloudflare build/configuration boundary rather than proving Worker source logic failure.
